description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'VoiceWakeSettings', managing voice wake configuration including microphone selection, trigger words, locale settings, test controls, and associated UI components for a macOS application.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct for configuring voice wake options, including microphone selection, trigger words, locale settings, test controls, and sound options.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: A model representing an audio input device with a UID and name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: A model for trigger words with a unique ID and value.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the app state into local trigger entries.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Synchronizes local trigger entries back to the app state trigger words array.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by ID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake test based on current state, manages timeouts and updates test status.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Builds a UI row for selecting and playing chimes.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom audio file as a chime.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the selected chime and plays it.

methods.name: sanitizedTriggers
methods.description: Returns sanitized list of trigger words.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command string from recognized transcript and triggers.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing refresh.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the stored microphone name based on current selection.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a microphone device list refresh.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported locales for speech recognition.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a locale.

methods.name: restartMeter
methods.description: Restarts the microphone level meter and updates the level indicator.
